text.tspan: Design strategy depends on the evidence available
CURRENT TOOL FAMILIES · Available interfaces do not establish that a proposed design is catalytically active.
What the resulting proposal must still establish
evaluation of the relevant chemical states.
a complementary pocket alone is insuﬃcient.
and experimental support for the intended reaction.
Source: design-agent interfaces. Examples include saturation scanning, motif scaﬀolding, DISCO and GENzyme; this ﬁgure reports tool roles, not a benchmark.
